threat: An unauthenticated local process reaches a state-changing management route (e.g. /v1/runtime install/start) and changes machine state.
A browser page on another origin obtains the dashboard token or makes the gateway trust it as the dashboard.
A provider-supplied endpoint or a stored connection causes a server-side request to a private/internal destination (SSRF).
A crafted backup envelope makes key derivation consume unbounded CPU and stalls the gateway event loop.
A prompt-influenced model escapes an operator-approved local-tool root via a symlink and reads outside files.
A credential reaches browser storage, a log, or version control.
A stale or recycled recorded PID causes the CLI launcher to signal an unrelated same-user process.
